verdict.rationale: Stripe documents HTTPS webhook endpoints that receive real-time event pushes to trigger automations. Terminal payments are managed in the same Stripe system as online payments, and refunds and disputes exist as Stripe concepts. However, the evidence never lists the specific lifecycle event types or ties webhook delivery to Terminal payments. Missing for 10: documented event types for authorized/captured/refunded/disputed, Terminal-specific webhook documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
